source.title: Original Dragon Isles prospecting reference and cross-site followup

notes: Fresh name-first numeric source search. Previously indexed independent study origins were not double-counted. No new Draconium, Serevite, Khaz'gorite, Prismatic, Bubble Poppy, or Saxifrage event-level histogram or resourcefulness reconciliation. Search returns represent qualitative mapping, existing original cohorts or unrelated gathering. Unknown statistics remain null.
lookingFor: Original Dragonflight Draconium/Serevite/Khaz'gorite/Prismatic prospecting and Bubble Poppy/Saxifrage milling completed-cast, per-output zero-and-hit histograms with verified input/output quality, specialization and refund logs
whereLooked: Reddit r/woweconomy — named Draconium Ore prospecting original per-cast histogram search (older Jallfo and ar_rules source families already indexed), https://www.reddit.com/r/woweconomy/comments/y3e8ek
Wowhead Dragon Isles Prospecting — Bugy's six original per-ore averages already indexed, not completed 0..N output events, https://www.wowhead.com/spell=374627/dragon-isles-prospecting
WoWhead Prismatic Ore — TheChisel, Hotfor, and superbondez original batches already indexed; no new hit histogram, https://www.wowhead.com/item=194545/prismatic-ore
Blizzard forum — by-name Bubble Poppy milling sample searches retrieved harvesting/alchemy rather than milling denominators, https://us.forums.blizzard.com/en/wow/t/windswept-bubble-poppy/1459285
Warcraft Wiki — by-name Saxifrage and Bubble Poppy milling lookup contains pigment mapping only, https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Pigment
Method — named Bubble Poppy/Saxifrage pigment guide has qualitative mappings without per-cast sample, https://www.method.gg/guides/what-dragonflight-herbs-do-you-need-to-mill-to-get-each-pigment
